articles.title: Defence ministry denies claims of unpaid house officers’ allowances
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has refuted allegations of non-payment of allowances to House Officers and Interns at Armed Forces Reference Hospitals. The Ministry firmly stated these claims are inaccurate, clarifying that all due payments have been disbursed. This statement assures prompt and proper remuneration for medical personnel serving within the armed forces healthcare system, upholding their welfare.

articles.title: India-Japan Defence Dialogue: Focus on tech innovation, industrial collaboration in Tokyo
articles.summary: India and Japan have formalized a partnership for co-production of the Naval Radio Antenna UNICORN. This strategic agreement, reached during Japanese PM Sanae Takaichi's New Delhi visit, strengthens defence cooperation and indigenous manufacturing. Defence Secretary Rajesh Kumar Singh's involvement highlights the commitment to enhance technological collaboration and maritime security, boosting capabilities for both nations.

articles.title: Peaky Blinders Team "Devastated," "Forever Grateful" for Sam Neill
articles.summary: The Peaky Blinders production team has expressed profound sorrow and gratitude following the death of renowned actor Sam Neill. They conveyed their devastation, emphasizing his invaluable contributions that significantly enriched the show. The team stated they would remain "forever grateful" for the artistic impact Neill brought to the acclaimed series, acknowledging his lasting legacy.

articles.title: Italy Leads NATO’s First Fully Multi-Domain Task Force X for the Integration of Autonomous Systems
articles.summary: Italy hosted and led Task Force X Central Mediterranean (TFX CentMed) from June 22 to July 10, 2026. This was the latest iteration of NATO Allied Command Transformation’s Task Force X framework, focusing on the Central Mediterranean. Such exercises are crucial for enhancing interoperability and collective defence capabilities among NATO allies, demonstrating strategic readiness in key regions.

articles.title: Houthis accuse Saudi Arabia of striking Sanaa airport, vow retaliation
articles.summary: The Iran-aligned Houthi movement in northern Yemen accused Saudi Arabia of launching air strikes on Sanaa's international airport on Monday, July 13. The Houthis, who control the capital, vowed to retaliate against Saudi Arabia, escalating tensions in the ongoing regional conflict. This incident highlights the volatile security situation and the broader proxy conflict in the Middle East.

articles.title: Sam Neill’s Career in Photos: ‘Jurassic Park,’ ‘The Piano,’ ‘Peaky Blinders’ and More
articles.summary: Acclaimed actor Sam Neill, celebrated for over five decades of iconic roles in blockbusters like 'Jurassic Park' and various independent films and TV series, has passed away at 78.
